recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes real current-source inconsistencies caused by the morphology move without reopening the rejected ServiceRequest multi-reference request; any independent audit of FHIR-41690 or FHIR-51792 should be handled as a separate issue decision.
issue_request: FHIR-48110 asked for ServiceRequest.bodyStructure to allow multiple BodyStructure references. Its Applied / Not Persuasive with Modification disposition rejected that cardinality change, directed morphology to move to BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology 0..1, and requested Procedure alignment back to 0..1.
initial_application: Commit 160b018e3bd0fa77ceb203775af97f1baacee6da moved BodyStructure.morphology into BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology and updated the BodyStructure morphology search parameter. Commit b78abd9628f3fdf2f562f0be50570487cc545f43 later applied FHIR-51792 by returning Procedure.bodyStructure to 0..1. The initial FHIR-48110 application left two BodyStructure examples using the removed root morphology element and left the moved element definition/diagram tooltip referring to BodyStructure.location.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists BodyStructure and ServiceRequest as current resources. Current ServiceRequest.bodyStructure and Procedure.bodyStructure are both max 1, matching the approved resolution and related PC/OO discussions. FHIR-41690 and FHIR-51792 explain the Procedure side of the same decision family but were not decided as separate reconciliation results here.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit on the combined branch that moves morphology inside includedStructure in the tumor and skin-patch BodyStructure examples, updates BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology definition text, and aligns the checked-in BodyStructure SVG tooltip with the authoritative definition.
source_changes: source/bodystructure/bodystructure-example-tumor.xml: moved the example morphology from a removed root BodyStructure child into includedStructure.morphology.
source/bodystructure/bodystructure-example-skin-patch.xml: moved the example morphology from a removed root BodyStructure child into includedStructure.morphology after qualifier.

source/bodystructure/structuredefinition-BodyStructure.xml: changed BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology definition text so it describes the included structure instead of the old BodyStructure.location path.
source/bodystructure/bodystructure.svg: aligned the checked-in morphology diagram tooltip with the updated authoritative definition.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Procedure/ServiceRequest multiple-bodyStructure request; later resolved No Change after FHIR-48110 and explains why Procedure cardinality was revisited rather than ServiceRequest expanded.
